site.headline: Full Stack Developer | Frontend Architecture | Enterprise SaaS | Payments
bio: I build production systems where performance, reliability, and business impact matter, from payment SDKs and compliance platforms to virtualized interfaces handling large datasets.

Recent work includes helping protect a high-value Allianz payments partnership through a 48-hour SDK delivery, stress-tested large-data table architecture for extreme row counts, and frontend modernization with materially faster loads.

hero.positioning: Enterprise SaaS, payments, and high-performance React systems.
hero.openTo: Open to full stack, frontend architecture, and SaaS roles.

payments-sdk.tagline: 48-hour Vanilla JS SDK for urgent enterprise payments deployment
payments-sdk.problem: Merchant checkout needed an embeddable payments layer under an immovable partnership deadline.
payments-sdk.built: Shipped a production-ready Vanilla JS SDK with theming, prefilled fields, and API-driven payment flows.
payments-sdk.impact: Helped protect a high-value Allianz payments partnership through rapid, reliable delivery.

horuz-compliance.tagline: Frontend architecture for a multi-tenant enterprise compliance platform
horuz-compliance.problem: Legacy CRA tooling and heavy UI modules slowed loads and complicated delivery for regulated workflows.
horuz-compliance.built: Modernized core modules with Vite, route-level code splitting, and a resilient state layer across the app.
horuz-compliance.impact: Cut initial JS payload and improved load times by a wide margin on core routes.

horuz-large-data.tagline: Virtualized hierarchy table for high-volume compliance records
horuz-large-data.problem: Compliance users needed snappy navigation through very large record sets without breaking the browser.
horuz-large-data.built: Implemented page-segmented virtualization with TanStack Virtual, cache-aware loading, and sizing for deep tables.
horuz-large-data.impact: Stress-tested large-data table architecture for extreme row counts while keeping interactions responsive.

demos.title: Production flows
demos.intro: Screen-by-screen walkthroughs from live payment and fundraising products — cropped to the product UI without browser chrome.

conservative-party.title: Conservative Party of Canada
conservative-party.description: End-to-end donation checkout for the Conservative Party of Canada — amount selection, donor contact, Interac e-Transfer and card payment paths, bank handoff, and error handling.
conservative-party.disclaimer: Screenshots are from a production-style staging environment. Personal data shown is sample data for demonstration purposes.

amount.title: Donation amount
amount.description: Donor picks a preset amount or enters a custom value. The modal keeps focus on the gift before collecting contact details.

contact.title: Contact & billing
contact.description: Legal name, email, address, and billing fields are captured for compliance, receipts, and payment routing.

payBy.title: Payment options
payBy.description: Donor chooses between card and Interac e-Transfer. The summary shows the selected amount before the payment rail opens.

paymentMethod.title: Interac selected
paymentMethod.description: Interac path is active in the checkout shell. The flow is about to hand off to bank selection or card entry depending on the rail.

cardCheckout.title: Card checkout
cardCheckout.description: Card form with amount summary, billing postal code, and the embedded Paybilt payment widget for secure card capture.

interacBanks.title: Interac bank selection
interacBanks.description: Financial institution grid so the donor can redirect to their online banking to complete the e-Transfer.

etransferWaiting.title: Waiting for e-Transfer
etransferWaiting.description: In-tab polling while the donor finishes e-Transfer in their bank. The checkout stays open until payment confirms or times out.

paymentDeclined.title: Payment declined
paymentDeclined.description: Error state when the payment fails or is rejected, with messaging so the donor can retry or choose another method.

bmo-allianz.title: BMO Travel Insurance Checkout
bmo-allianz.description: Embeddable payments SDK inside Allianz’s BMO-branded quote flow — iframe checkout with traveller review, contact capture, Apple Pay, Interac e-Transfer, and credit card rails, plus bank handoff and in-tab payment polling.
bmo-allianz.disclaimer: Screenshots are from a production-style environment on sales.allianz-assistance.ca. Personal data shown is sample data for demonstration purposes.

reviewPayment.title: Review & payment
reviewPayment.description: Traveller and policy summary with total due. The embeddable checkout iframe opens the payment step without leaving the Allianz quote flow.

contactInfo.title: Contact information
contactInfo.description: Purchaser details and address fields inside the SDK modal, prefilled where possible from the host page context.

validationErrors.title: Form validation
validationErrors.description: Inline validation on required fields before payment can continue — keeps bad submissions out of the payment rails.

creditCard.title: Credit card checkout
creditCard.description: Card entry with amount summary and billing postal code, using the same embeddable widget pattern as other Paybilt merchants.

applePay.title: Apple Pay
applePay.description: Wallet rail for supported devices. One-tap confirmation after the donor selects Apple Pay in the method list.

interacEtransfer.title: Interac e-Transfer
interacEtransfer.description: Interac option in the method picker before bank handoff. Amount and policy context stay visible in the host frame.

waitingPayment.title: Waiting for payment
waitingPayment.description: Polling state while the donor completes payment in another tab or bank session. The iframe shows progress until success or failure.

interacBanks.title: Interac bank selection
interacBanks.description: FI grid for redirect to online banking. Same Interac handoff pattern as fundraising checkout, tuned for insurance purchase context.

allianz-sdk.headline: Protected a major payments partnership
allianz-sdk.story: Built and shipped a Vanilla JS payments SDK in 48 hours for an urgent Allianz deployment.

vite-migration.headline: Frontend architecture upgrade
vite-migration.story: Reduced app bundle size and improved load performance by migrating from CRA to Vite, code-splitting key routes, and optimizing production builds.

virtualization.headline: Large data interface
virtualization.story: Built a virtualized enterprise table using TanStack Virtual with segmented scroll logic for high-volume compliance records.

auth-state.headline: Auth and state refactor
auth-state.story: Improved app reliability by moving auth and shared app state toward a cleaner Zustand-based architecture.

horuz-v2.title: Horuz V2 Modernization
horuz-v2.context: Enterprise compliance SaaS used by engineering, legal, and construction teams.
horuz-v2.constraint: Legacy CRA stack and large datasets caused load bottlenecks and difficult scaling.
built: Led modernization of six core modules: Dashboard, Obligations, Frameworks, Authentication, Actions, and Files.
Migrated from CRA to Vite, introducing lazy loading, route-level code splitting, and caching.
Designed page-segmented virtualization with TanStack Virtual and cache-aware loading.
metrics: 200K+ records per segment; stress-tested near 1M rows

pcc-sdk.title: PCC / Allianz Payments SDK
pcc-sdk.context: Custom embeddable payment SDK for merchant checkout flows.
pcc-sdk.constraint: Critical partnership deadline required full delivery in 48 hours.
built: Built a Vanilla JS SDK in one weekend with CSS theming, dynamic prefill, and locked fields.
Integrated API-triggered payment workflows for enterprise merchant onboarding.
Shipped a stable implementation under tight delivery constraints.

occ-platform.title: OCC Donation Platform
occ-platform.context: Fundraising platform for Conservative Party of Canada donation flow.
occ-platform.constraint: Needed measurable conversion lift while handling compliant payments at scale.
built: Helped deliver OCC V1 donation platform with production-grade payment flow.
Led a four-person frontend team for OCC V2 one-click checkout rebuild.
Improved checkout UX while preserving compliance requirements.
metrics: Supported $1M+ weekly transactions across live systems

template-registry.title: Template Registry Service
template-registry.context: Template and status system for complex payment notification and workflow rendering.
template-registry.constraint: Frontend duplication and support issues were slowing delivery across many merchant flows.
built: Built FastAPI + MongoDB service to centralize Jinja2 templates and status handling.
Enabled single-template handling for many payment states through composable rules.
Reduced support overhead by stabilizing template reuse and rendering reliability.

oasis-mobile.title: Oasis Real Estate App
oasis-mobile.context: Cross-platform real estate app for brokers and clients.
oasis-mobile.constraint: Rapid contract build with real-time chat and map-heavy interactions across platforms.
built: Developed app architecture using Clean Architecture and BLoC.
Implemented real-time chat with typing indicators, read receipts, and reconnection logic.
Integrated maps, search, favorites, comparisons, and secure REST API workflows.

zamzam.title: Zam Zam Bags and Boutique
zamzam.context: Small-business web experience for product showcase and customer discovery.
zamzam.constraint: Needed a polished and responsive storefront presence with quick iteration cycles.
built: Designed and delivered a responsive site for the business.
Balanced visual identity with maintainable frontend implementation.
Supported product presentation and customer contact flows.
